title: Account Security lets an instructor change her password, sign out other sessions and delete her account
acceptance: A signed-in email account can change its password from Account without signing out.
Account can sign out every other session.
Self-service account deletion exists before the beta expands (D22), including provider-token and metadata purge.
The Security copy says plainly what Ritmo owns for email accounts and what Apple owns for Sign in with Apple.
Any new auth or deletion endpoint is registered in OpenAPI; the iOS snapshot refresh is a separate iOS PR.
nextAction: Plan after RF-116 (password reset revokes old sessions), which shares the session code. Deletion is likely its own child record with schema and purge design. Files: apps/api auth routes and Better Auth config, apps/web Dashboard Account section. Owner-gated (auth): the PR needs owner-approved. Surface: both (auth API).

evidence.summary: The account-security section is one paragraph and a privacy link; no password, session or deletion control. Checked on main c9b89a7.
D22 privacy boundary: account deletion may be manual during the small beta; self-service deletion is required before expansion.
2026-10-28 owner UX audit of production: Top priority 9 and the Account Security rows. Browser evidence; not re-observed at intake.
